CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugins (
      uuid         TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      ouid         TEXT,
      plugins_type TEXT,
      version      TEXT,
      name         TEXT,
      "desc"       TEXT,
      create_by    TEXT,
      cover        TEXT,
      status       TEXT DEFAULT 'draft',
      public       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      updated_by   TEXT,
      created_at   INTEGER,
      updated_at   INTEGER,
      deleted_at   INTEGER,
      installed    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      install_path TEXT,
      enabled      INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      target       TEXT DEFAULT 'common',
      platform     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'win',
      use_ai       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      mask         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_categories (
      id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      uuid         TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      type_name    TEXT UNIQUE,
      icon         TEXT,
      parent_uuid  TEXT,
      sort_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_by   TEXT,
      updated_by   TEXT,
      created_at   INTEGER,
      updated_at   INTEGER,
      deleted_at   INTEGER
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_versions (
      id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      plugin_uuid    TEXT,
      version        TEXT,
      changelog      TEXT,
      file_path      TEXT,
      file_size      INTEGER,
      file_hash      TEXT,
      file_type      TEXT DEFAULT 'zip',
      min_engine_ver TEXT,
      max_engine_ver TEXT,
      status         TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
      is_latest      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_by     TEXT,
      created_at     INTEGER,
      updated_at     INTEGER,
      deleted_at     INTEGER,
      UNIQUE(plugin_uuid, version)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_configs (
      id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      plugin_uuid   TEXT,
      version_id    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      param_key     TEXT,
      param_type    TEXT,
      default_value TEXT,
      required      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      description   TEXT,
      options       TEXT,
      sort_order    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at    INTEGER,
      updated_at    INTEGER,
      UNIQUE(plugin_uuid, version_id, param_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_installs (
      id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      plugin_uuid  TEXT NOT NULL,
      version      TEXT NOT NULL,
      install_path TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_hash    TEXT,
      enabled      INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      status       TEXT DEFAULT 'installed',
      started_at   INTEGER,
      last_error   TEXT,
      created_at   INTEGER,
      updated_at   INTEGER,
      UNIQUE(plugin_uuid, version)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_relations (
      id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      plugin_uuid   TEXT NOT NULL,
      related_uuid  TEXT NOT NULL,
      relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at    INTEGER,
      UNIQUE(plugin_uuid, related_uuid, relation_type)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_libs (
      id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      uuid          TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      plugin_uuid   TEXT NOT NULL,
      version       TEXT,
      name          TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_name     TEXT NOT NULL,
      platform      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'windows',
      target        TEXT DEFAULT 'common',
      install_path  TEXT,
      libary_path   TEXT,
      file_hash     TEXT,
      file_size     INTEGER,
      is_local      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      is_registered INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      load_ok       INTEGER DEFAULT -1,
      last_check_at INTEGER,
      created_at    INTEGER,
      updated_at    INTEGER,
      UNIQUE(plugin_uuid, platform, name)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_functions (
      uuid           TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      plugin_uuid    TEXT NOT NULL,
      ffi_symbol     TEXT NOT NULL,
      title          TEXT NOT NULL,
      description    TEXT NOT NULL,
      params_schema  TEXT NOT NULL,
      params_example TEXT,
      return_schema  TEXT NOT NULL,
      return_example TEXT,
      use_ai         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at     INTEGER,
      updated_at     INTEGER
    )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugins_target ON plugins(target)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugins_status ON plugins(status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugins_name ON plugins(name)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_categories_parent ON plugin_categories(parent_uuid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_versions_latest ON plugin_versions(plugin_uuid, is_latest)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_configs_plugin ON plugin_configs(plugin_uuid, version_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_installs_plugin ON plugin_installs(plugin_uuid, status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_relations_type ON plugin_relations(plugin_uuid, relation_type)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_libs_plugin ON plugin_libs(plugin_uuid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_libs_name ON plugin_libs(name)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_libs_local ON plugin_libs(is_local, platform)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_functions_lookup ON plugin_functions(ffi_symbol)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_plugin_configs_key ON plugin_configs(plugin_uuid, version_id, param_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_categories (
      code        TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      name        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      sort        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at  DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
